dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature forming a distinctive falcate spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse geometric profile and a medium pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with approximately 50-degree steepness relative to the dorsal horizontal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1:1.1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex semi-circular arc with a moderate radius transition from the blowhole region toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a thick pixel width relative to length extending from the cranial inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope terminates at the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable light-colored depigmented patch on the distal trailing edge of the right pectoral fin; faint linear striations on the lower lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Deeply notched caudal flukes with symmetrical trailing edges and a distinct median indentation.
